plainTranslation: A's mind meets B's dreams. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking sit right on top of your imagination, hope, and idealism. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: But the same wordless understanding can become a problem. Because so much is happening beneath the surface, very little may be spoken outright. You can start to believe that what feels true to you must also be true for them. Agreements are assumed instead of discussed. Expectations take shape without ever being named. Choices linger in the space between you, waiting for someone to claim them, while both of you trust that the other already knows. Later, confusion appears. You may feel certain an agreement was made, while they may feel no agreement ever existed. And both of you are telling your truth.
advice: This aspect asks you to trust what you sense without treating it as certainty. Feelings carry truth, yet they do not always communicate the whole truth.
summaryShort: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking sit right on top of your imagination, hope, and idealism.
